resources.string: Where the main menu sits: the sidebar, a bar across the top, a floating pill, Glass (frosted, over the Modern home) or Cinematic Glass (Glass with the artwork full screen); with other layouts both Glass styles show the pill. The sidebar is the default.
Draws the Glass menu without live blur or liquid glass. Devices with little memory or older than Android 12 always do; liquid glass needs Android 13 and memory to spare.
Shows the time beside the top menu, in this device\'s 12- or 24-hour format.
Dims the screen when nothing is pressed for a while. Never during playback.
Off by default. Any button wakes the screen without doing anything else.
How long without a button press before the screen dims.
